name: Trial at the Field of Giants

meta.wiki: Trial at the Field of Giants

summary: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem sends warrior aspirants south to face an unfamiliar foe. They must slay silithid in the Field of Giants and return with several twitching antennae within half an hour.

sections.title: A Test of Speed and Steel
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem challenges growing warriors to prove themselves against an unfamiliar adversary. The Horde's warrior trainers test more than combat skill: aspirants must slay the creatures and bring back fresh antennae within half an hour. The run across the southern Barrens tests their speed and resolve, while the antennae must still twitch when they reach Taurajo.

sections.title: Unwelcome Intruders
sections.body: Silithid hives rise in the Field of Giants, beneath massive fossilized ribcages. The bizarre, crawling insects are recent arrivals in the Barrens, disturbing tauren hunters and shamans who watch the savannas. Ruga says their presence bodes ill for Kalimdor. The trial tests a young warrior's instincts in combat and gathers intelligence on a growing threat to the land.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on the antennae?
faq.answer: Ruga Ragetotem requires the antennae to still twitch when warriors bring them to Camp Taurajo, giving them only thirty minutes for the hunt and return. Their freshness proves the aspirant slew a silithid in direct combat rather than scavenging a dead one.

faq.q: What creatures live at the Field of Giants?
faq.answer: Bizarre, aggressive silithid burrowers live in the Field of Giants. They have excavated massive mounds and hives beneath ancient fossils, disturbing the local ecology and alarming the Horde.

Ruga Ragetotem is a tauren warrior trainer at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He oversees trials for Horde warriors seeking to advance their standing, testing their skill, resilience, and speed.

faq.q: Where is the Field of Giants located?
aliases: where do i find the bugs
faq.answer: The Field of Giants lies directly south of Camp Taurajo, beside the road before the southern pass toward Thousand Needles. Towering skeletal ribcages and silithid mounds mark the field.

faq.q: Where does this training chain lead next?
faq.answer: After the warrior returns the twitching antennae in time, Ruga sends them to Thun'grim Firegaze, an elder orc blacksmith who lives atop a hill east of the Crossroads. Thun'grim will craft armor for proven warriors.

faq.q: Why are the tauren concerned about the insects?
faq.answer: Ruga says the silithid are unnatural newcomers to the Barrens and that their arrival bodes ill for the land. He suspects their aggressive burrowing and expansion point to a greater danger beneath the sands.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face this rite of passage around level twenty. It tests how quickly you can overcome swarming foes and endure a strict time limit.
As a tauren defender, you help protect the hunting grounds around Camp Taurajo by confronting the desecration at the Field of Giants and its unnatural, invasive hive.
As a member of the Horde, you face the expanding silithid presence in the southern Barrens. These trials also gather information about a creeping threat.
